note.en: When the task marker also resolves as a link reference (`[x]`), the reference strips only the first text token, so the marker link stays in the item and its text is duplicated; our package removes all parsed marker tokens.

cases.name: marker-as-link-reference

notes.en: `ulClass` / `liClass` are mapped to `containerClass` / `itemClass` with the reference defaults (`task-list` / `task-list-item`); `divWrap` stays `false` and `disabled` stays `true` on the reference side.
notes.zh: `ulClass` / `liClass` 映射为 `containerClass` / `itemClass`，取参考包默认值（`task-list` / `task-list-item`）；参考包侧的 `divWrap` 保持 `false`，`disabled` 保持 `true`。

notes.en: Both packages label the item text, but the structure differs by design: the current package nests the checkbox inside `<label class="task-list-item-label">` and emits no ids, while the reference emits `<input id="cbx_N"><label for="cbx_N">`. Normalization unwraps the label tags and removes the generated `cbx_*` ids, so the compared part is the list structure, container/item classes, checkbox state and item text.
notes.zh: 两个包都会为条目文本加标签，但结构在设计上不同：当前包把复选框嵌套在 `<label class="task-list-item-label">` 内且不生成 id，参考包则输出 `<input id="cbx_N"><label for="cbx_N">`。归一化会去掉 `label` 标签并移除生成的 `cbx_*` id，因此参与比较的部分是列表结构、容器/条目 class、复选框状态和条目文本。

notes.en: `checkboxClass` is set to an empty string because the reference emits no class on the checkbox; the resulting empty `class` attribute is normalized away. The current package's extra `labelClass` is not observable after the label tags are normalized.
notes.zh: `checkboxClass` 设为空字符串，因为参考包不会在复选框上输出 class；由此产生的空 `class` 属性会被归一化去掉。`label` 标签归一化后，当前包额外的 `labelClass` 已不可观测。

notes.en: `checked="checked"` / `disabled="disabled"` and the reference `checked="true"` / `disabled="true"` are equivalent boolean attributes; the normalizer canonicalizes them to the bare attribute.
notes.zh: `checked="checked"` / `disabled="disabled"` 与参考包的 `checked="true"` / `disabled="true"` 是等价的布尔属性；归一化器会将它们统一为不带值的属性。

notes.en: Scaling: the reference locates the parent list token with a backward scan through the token stream for every task item, which is quadratic in the number of items in one list; the current package records the last token index per nesting level in one forward pass and stays linear. `many-task-items` exposes the difference.
notes.zh: 扩展性：参考包为每个任务条目回溯扫描 token 流以定位父列表 token，在单个列表的条目数上呈二次增长；当前包在一次前向遍历中记录每个嵌套层级的最后一个 token 下标，保持线性。`many-task-items` 体现了这一差异。
